0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest) are on the road against the Phoenix Suns (1-5, on a four-game losing streak) in the Rockets' 10th game of the season. Houston is without Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Clint Capela is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (out, calf) and Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and has Rasheer Fleming listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain. The Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 4-0 and beat Phoenix 119-105 in their last meeting, in Phoenix on April 7, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
